question: 我想知道，在所有三甲医院周边500米范围内，那些10层及以上的住宅楼，平均有多少层？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(b."Floor") FROM cq_buildings_2021 b JOIN cq_amap_poi_2024 p ON ST_DWithin(b.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography, 500) WHERE (p."名称" LIKE '%三甲%' OR p."类型" LIKE '%三甲%') AND p."类型" LIKE '%医院%' AND b."Floor" >= 10;
pred_sql:
WITH sanjia_hospitals AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM cq_amap_poi_2024
    WHERE "类型" LIKE '%医院%'
      AND ("名称" LIKE '%三甲%' OR "类型" LIKE '%三甲%')
),
residential_land AS (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM cq_land_use_dltb
    WHERE "DLBM" LIKE '05%'
),
qualified_buildings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b."Id", b."Floor"
    FROM cq_buildings_2021 b
    JOIN residential_land rl ON ST_Intersects(b.geometry, rl.geometry)
    WHERE b."Floor" >= 10
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sanjia_hospitals h
        WHERE ST_DWithin(b.geometry::geography, h.geometry::geography, 500)
      )
)
SELECT AVG("Floor") FROM qualified_buildings LIMIT 100000
